description: This file contains the implementation of the Metadata class, including methods for walking and rebasing metadata, as well as extensive documentation on metadata collection and aggregation in the GN build system.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class responsible for handling metadata collection, walking, and rebasing within the GN build system.

methods.name: Metadata::WalkStep
methods.description: Performs a walk step over metadata, collecting data based on specified keys and walk keys, with support for rebasing paths.

methods.name: Metadata::RebaseValue
methods.description: Rebases a metadata value according to the specified rebase directory, handling different value types.

methods.name: Metadata::RebaseStringValue
methods.description: Rebases a string value representing a filename within metadata.

methods.name: Metadata::RebaseListValue
methods.description: Rebases a list of metadata values.

methods.name: Metadata::RebaseScopeValue
methods.description: Rebases a scope value within metadata, updating contained values.
